diagnosis.prior_status_setup_and_residency_repairs: The run used the declared X Special, made exactly three role transitions, cleared status before every attack, and assigned every grounded target to Dugtrio.
diagnosis.direct_contract_failure: The targetless switch action was bound to Blastoise for Golbat, so Jolteon never attacked and the required specialist-role coverage failed.
diagnosis.causal_boundary: The classifier predicted the high-level switch class, but the selected party member came from a hand-written matchup score rather than learned target authority.
diagnosis.offline_evidence: The existing deterministic resolver agrees with 22 of 28 explicit training-lineage targets and 10 of 13 held-out-lineage targets. Its portable mechanics rank cannot reproduce every demonstrated role assignment.
diagnosis.correct_abstraction: Treat switch timing and switch-target selection as distinct learned decisions. Project every legal reserve independently and train a permutation-equivariant listwise target ranker on whole-lineage splits before another full replay.

repair.direction: Build and qualify an offline candidate-relative switch-target ranker; keep the deterministic resolver as an explicitly reported baseline until the learned target passes held-out and permutation gates.
